t: The Universal Translator: A Graceful Degradation Strategy for AI Tool Calling
s: This article proposes a 'golden path' for AI tool interaction using graceful degradation, allowing formal to simple syntaxes for robust AI-human collaboration and a safer development workflow.
sub: AI-assisted git workflow risks and infinite regression
Graceful degradation for AI tool calling across syntaxes
Proactive branching strategy to prevent AI learning from buggy code
Maintaining continuity in AI-assisted coding sessions
